stories.title: Methanogenic archaea Methanobrevibacter smithii and Methanosphaera stadtmanae promote mucosal homeostasis and protect from colitis
stories.authors_source: Emily E. Byrd, Benjamin W. Harris, Hongpan Zhang et al. — PNAS (online October 20; issue October 27, 2026)
stories.takeaway: Two human-associated methanogens enhance mucus, epithelial regeneration and regulatory T-cell responses in mice.
stories.what_happened: Gnotobiotic and antibiotic-treated mice showed goblet-cell expansion, thicker mucus, increased Treg cells and less DSS colitis; adaptive-immune requirements differed between species.
stories.method: Germ-free and antibiotic-treated mouse colonization, colonic transcriptomics, mucosal histology, immune profiling and DSS colitis.
stories.why_it_matters: Broadens the study of gut microbial function beyond bacteria, with directly testable epithelial and immune readouts.
stories.read_first: Compare methanogen-specific immune dependence and goblet-cell/mucus measurements.
stories.caveat: Mouse protection does not demonstrate clinical benefit or safety in human IBD.

stories.title: Inflammatory memory primes the intestine for enhanced regenerative potential
stories.authors_source: Borja Arozamena, Ilias Moraitis, Loris Mularoni et al. — Nature Communications (October 27, 2026)
stories.takeaway: Inflammation and plasticity imprint persistent stem-cell states that improve responses to subsequent injury.
stories.what_happened: Single-cell multiomics identifies transcriptional and epigenetic memory in intestinal stem cells and descendants, with IFN-gamma implicated as a driver.
stories.method: Intestinal injury and regeneration models with single-cell multiomic profiling and mechanistic inflammatory-signal analysis.
stories.why_it_matters: Provides a framework to distinguish transient epithelial stress from durable regeneration-associated programming.
stories.read_first: Read the single-cell memory comparisons and IFN-gamma perturbation experiments.
stories.caveat: Regenerative priming in models does not imply that prolonged inflammation is protective.

stories.title: Epithelial NF-κB shapes protective Treg cell responses to restrain intestinal inflammation
stories.authors_source: Luisa Barleben, Antony Julián Schneegans, Marina Kolesnichenko et al. — Nature Communications (October 20, 2026)
stories.takeaway: Epithelial NF-κB can coordinate protective Treg recruitment and conditioning during colitis recovery.
stories.what_happened: Mouse genetic models and human UC organoids link epithelial NF-κB activity to CCL22-mediated Treg recruitment and tissue-adapted immune suppression.
stories.method: UC biopsies, epithelial organoids, DSS mouse models, NF-κB reporters, scRNA-seq, secretomics, CellChat, transwell assays and Treg transfer.
stories.why_it_matters: Challenges the assumption that epithelial and immune NF-κB activation are functionally equivalent in intestinal inflammation.
stories.read_first: Focus on epithelial CCL22 loss-of-function, Treg transfer and human UC organoid responses.
stories.caveat: Most causal protection experiments are in mice; cell-type and timing specificity limit therapeutic extrapolation.

stories.title: Directed differentiation with mechanical simulation enhances alveolar-like features in human pluripotent stem cell-derived lung epithelium
stories.authors_source: Yuetong Song, Jeremy Newton, Kimia Abedi et al. — Communications Biology (October 26, 2026)
stories.publication_type: Peer-reviewed primary research; early-view accepted article
stories.takeaway: Direct epithelial-fibroblast contact and microfluidic cyclic stretch improve differentiation toward alveolar-like states.
stories.what_happened: Researchers generated high-purity fetal lung progenitors, tested direct fibroblast co-culture with Notch inhibition, then added cyclic stretch at an air-liquid interface.
stories.method: hPSC differentiation, distal bud-tip organoids, epithelial-mesenchymal co-culture, microfluidic air-liquid interface, cyclic stretch and molecular/ultrastructural assays.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows why mechanical stimulation and direct stromal contact should be experimentally separated in human tissue engineering.
stories.read_first: Start with contact-versus-paracrine comparisons, then stretch and maturation readouts.
stories.caveat: Fetal-like cells and model-specific readouts do not establish fully adult alveolar function.

stories.title: A three-dimensional human co-culture system reveals reciprocal embryo–endometrial adaptation at implantation onset
stories.authors_source: Yan Bi, Zhifen Tu, Xinbao Zhang et al. — Nature Cell Biology (October 27, 2026)
stories.takeaway: A human blastoid/endometrial assembloid co-culture resolves reciprocal cell-state adaptation and CSF3-dependent signaling.
stories.what_happened: Time-course single-cell profiles reveal stromal-dependent SDC1+MMP7+ trophoblast subsets, endometrial decidualization changes and CSF3–CSF3R contributions.
stories.method: 3D endometrial assembloid co-culture with blastoids and blastocysts, time-series scRNA-seq, cell communication analysis and targeted perturbation.
stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates a functional strategy to move from cell-interaction predictions to perturbation in complex human co-cultures.
stories.read_first: Read CSF3–CSF3R perturbation and cross-model validation of trophoblast states.
stories.caveat: Implantation-like culture states cannot be assumed to represent clinical pregnancy outcomes.

stories.title: Single-cell landscape of human adipose tissue reveals THBS1 as a potential driver of fibro-inflammation in metabolic disease
stories.authors_source: Hejiao Zhang et al. not applicable; lead authors per journal article — Nature Communications (October 27, 2026)
stories.takeaway: THBS1-high adipose populations associate with obesity and diabetes and contribute to macrophage-mediated TGF-beta activation.
stories.what_happened: Human adipose atlases plus tissue and mouse perturbations support a THBS1-dependent fibro-inflammatory mechanism and candidate biomarker association.
stories.method: Human single-nucleus and bulk transcriptomics, primary cells, explants, mouse perturbations and antibody neutralization.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates combining tissue atlases with mechanistic validation of paracrine fibrosis signaling.
stories.read_first: Read the THBS1-high subpopulation definition and neutralization experiments.
stories.caveat: Ethnically homogeneous cohort and incomplete independent diagnostic validation limit generalizability.

stories.title: Ureterovesical junction: a stem cell niche for ureteral urothelial renewal and bladder urothelial injury repair
stories.authors_source: Yi Liao, Fenglin Zhang, Y. Liu et al. — Nature Communications (October 26, 2026)
stories.publication_type: Peer-reviewed primary research; early-view accepted article
stories.takeaway: A Foxa2-expressing ureterovesical stem-cell niche contributes to bladder epithelial repair after severe injury.
stories.what_happened: Lineage tracing shows UVJ cells remain localized in homeostasis but migrate after severe bladder denudation, alongside TRKA/AKT activation.
stories.method: Label retention, lineage tracing, urothelial organoids and chemical/mechanical bladder injury models.
stories.why_it_matters: Offers a comparative example of niche-dependent epithelial plasticity and injury-threshold-dependent repair.
stories.read_first: Focus on lineage-tracing differences between mild and severe injury and TRKA/AKT experiments.
stories.caveat: Urinary tract regeneration should not be directly extrapolated to gut epithelium.

stories.title: Targeting CD44v6 and PI3K disrupts HGF-driven reprogramming of colorectal cancer stem cells
stories.authors_source: Kimiya Shams, Francesco Verona, Simone Di Franco et al. — Cell Death Discovery (October 26, 2026)
stories.takeaway: Combined blockade of HGF-associated stemness pathways and PI3K signaling reduces adaptive colorectal cancer cell responses in models.
stories.what_happened: HGF induces hybrid EMT-like programs; compensatory signaling persists under CD44v6/c-Met targeting, while apitolisib suppresses growth and increases in-vitro chemotherapy vulnerability.
stories.method: Colorectal cancer stem-cell assays, mouse avatars, pathway perturbation and drug-response testing.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates compensatory signaling and the need for multiple readouts in patient-relevant cancer models.
stories.read_first: Read HGF reprogramming and the inhibitor-combination response plots.
stories.caveat: Preclinical response does not establish patient benefit, and PI3K/mTOR inhibitors have tolerability considerations.

stories.title: Machine learning dataset and benchmark for accurate T cell receptor–pHLA binding prediction
stories.authors_source: Xinyuan Zhu, Jiadong Lu, Yeqing Lu et al. — Nature Computational Science (October 26, 2026)
stories.takeaway: Hi-TPH combines hierarchical binding data with protein language models to improve TCR–pHLA predictions on an external experimental benchmark.
stories.what_happened: Authors address biased negative data and incomplete receptor sequences; reported performance improves 19.2% over comparator tools on an external wet-lab set.
stories.method: Hierarchical immune-binding dataset curation, negative sampling, PLM fine-tuning and external benchmarking.
stories.why_it_matters: A useful example of dataset-design rigor and independent evaluation in computational immunology.
stories.read_first: Read negative-data generation and external wet-lab test-set design before performance claims.
stories.caveat: Performance depends on data composition and may not transfer to unrepresented HLA alleles or clinical use.

stories.title: Direct imaging elucidates ionic memory in two-dimensional nanochannels
stories.authors_source: Kalluvadi Veetil Saurav, Nathan Ronceray, Baptiste Coquinot et al. — Nature Materials (October 27, 2026)
stories.takeaway: Operando imaging reveals voltage-driven wall blistering as a physical origin of ionic-memory hysteresis in nanochannels.
stories.what_happened: Interferometric imaging and electrokinetics distinguish electrostatic and osmotic blister mechanisms in confined 2D channels.
stories.method: Operando interferometric imaging, nanofluidic transport measurements and electromechanical analysis.
stories.why_it_matters: Provides a physical micro/nanofluidics lesson on how deformable boundaries change flow and device behavior.
stories.read_first: Start with blister imaging under voltage and hysteresis correlations.
stories.caveat: Nanochannel ionic memristors are not direct evidence about biological microfluidic chips.
